written: 2026-09-05, from the fixture sources, BEFORE the CLI was run
question: Where is a referenced member declared, how many files must be opened to establish that, and by which mechanism — asked once per mechanism, with the framework question deliberately excluded.

rows.subject: App\Support\Direct::run
rows.why: The control. One file beyond the changed one, the member is there, and this is the fetch-collaborator move exactly as Experiment 4 earned it.

rows.subject: App\Support\Direct::slug
rows.why: Ownership decides, never the name. `slug` is the project's, so it is fetched like any other project member — the guard M5 built, restated here as a control.

rows.subject: App\Support\OneLevel::run
rows.why: PHP guarantees OneLevel::run() resolves to Direct::run(). A reviewer asking what the call does needs that body, and it is project code. This is ADR-A010's own minimal case (S05) in project form.
rows.blocked_by: ADR-A010 D2 — one file beyond the changed file.

rows.subject: App\Support\TwoLevel::run
rows.why: Deliberately NOT FETCH. Two intermediate files is where a bounded hop stops being bounded, and no evidence asks for it. A flag is the honest output; this row exists to define the far side of any boundary M8 might draw.

rows.subject: App\Support\WithTrait::greet
rows.mechanism: trait applied on the class itself
rows.why: Same distance as X8.3 by a different language construct, and equally guaranteed by PHP. If a boundary admits one it should admit the other, or the rule keys on syntax rather than on distance.

rows.subject: App\Support\ViaParent::greet
rows.mechanism: trait applied on the PARENT (the E5.4 shape)
rows.why: THE ROW THE TRIGGER IS ABOUT. This is `MenuPdfController -> Controller -> ApiResponse::success` exactly: an abstract parent that declares nothing and applies a trait. It is THREE files from the changed one, so even a one-hop relaxation does not reach it. Expected FLAG, and the answer key records that a flag here is a loss the reviewer feels.

rows.subject: App\Support\Dynamic::create
rows.declared_at: nowhere — it exists only at runtime
rows.why: Eloquent's shape without Laravel. No file declares `create`; no traversal of any depth finds it. This is the control proving that the depth boundary is not what blocks G2 — nothing is there to reach.

rows.subject: App\Support\Direct::nope
rows.why: Must remain flagged. The class is placed and read; the member genuinely is not there.

rows.subject: App\Support\Direct::runn
rows.why: The silent-omission guard, restated. Any rule that settles X8.3 must not settle this.

rows.subject: $this->instanceGreet(...)
rows.why: G5's true shape. The reviewer needs the contract, and today the tool emits NOTHING — no item, no diagnostic. P10 rates a silent omission worse than a flag, so the key asks for at least a flag. Note the blocker here is EXTRACTION, not depth: no assertion is formed at all, so relaxing the depth bound would change nothing.
